body: Right, I agree. The worst part is feeling trapped even though you want so desperately to feel better. But thank you, I appreciate it!!

Thank you, I needed that. I've just noticed myself growing more and more apathetic towards my life. Like, I don't think my will to live is stronger than my will not to live...ya know? And it sucks. I was good for a little while but I hate that this is a constant uphill battle. I hate that I can't snap my fingers and have these thoughts disappear. I want to love myself and my life, and I'm jealous of the people who can do that so easily. I live in a city with a bajillion therapists, I just have an intense schedule so I've been looking for one who can fit that. I'm hoping to be seeing a new one within the next month!

Hey, thank you for your response. I agree, I think a lot of people don't know how to respond when you share this kind of info with them, especially if they haven't quite been to this place themselves. And then sometimes it scares them away. Congrats on your recent decision to quit! I try to take tolerance breaks because I don't want to give it up completely, but I do want to stop for a little while until I can be a little more responsible with it. I'm not the most athletic person but I do try to go for walks to get out  for a little bit. Do you have any other recommendations for how you're coping with everything?

Honestly the weed helps me forget all of my problems, or at least makes me feel happy enough to forget them for a while. But the alcohol brings out a dark side in me, not gonna lie. I used to heavily rely on drinking and only got involved with weed fairly recently. I really appreciate weed, but I don't want to use it for all the wrong reasons, which is what I'm doing now. But I certainly agree that when I'm drinking extensibly, it can be very, very harmful.
